dct_description_sm: Nicaragua administrative level 0-2 boundaries, gazetteer, and geoservices. COD-EM datasets do not replace the authoritative COD-AB available here; however COD-EM datasets may be preferred for cartographic purposes. See caveats. These boundaries are NOT suitable for database or GIS linkage to the [Nicaragua - Subnational Population Statistics](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ps-nic) tables, which do not have compatible P-coding. Vetting by [Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS)](https://www.uga.edu/) with funding from USAID.
